claim_action: If sensitivity is observed, restrict exact/non-identifiability claims to specified hashed digital operators and treat real-pipeline transfer as conditional/approximate.
important_scope: These are predeclared digital-operator stress tests. Integer/half-voxel shifts approximate discretization/registration mismatch on the 91x109x91 grid; dropout/jitter are uncalibrated support/weight stresses. They are not an empirical distribution of registration error and cannot establish biological operator exactness.
